name: Gwynant Minesweeper
subtitle: Logic, not luck. No ads.
promotionalText: Classic Minesweeper where every board can be solved by logic alone, so you never have to guess. Four sizes, made for one hand. No ads, ever.
description:
Minesweeper, calm and fair.

Every board can be cleared by logic alone, so a game is never lost to a coin toss. Your first tap always opens an area, and a misstep can be taken back with undo.

FOUR SIZES, MADE FOR PHONES
• Easy: 9 × 9, 10 mines
• Medium: 10 × 14, 24 mines
• Hard: 12 × 18, 40 mines
• Expert: 12 × 20, 52 mines

MADE FOR PLAYING
• Tall boards that fit the screen, no pinching or scrolling
• Switch between opening and flagging with one tap
• Tap a number to clear around it

CALM BY DESIGN
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no tracking. Ever.
• Light and dark themes that follow your device
• Soft, optional sounds and gentle haptics
• Your game is saved the moment you leave
• Statistics for every mode, kept on your device

Gwynant games are free and open source, made with care in the spirit of Llyn Gwynant: quiet, simple and unhurried.
